newer_changes_search: Web search (socialjustice.gov.in, PIB, NSP, state portals) for 2025-2026 changes to PM-YASASVI post-matric: no revised guidelines and no Cabinet decision on a 2026-31 cycle found; 2026-27 applications and renewals are open through NSP/state portals on the existing terms (income limit Rs 2.5 lakh, course-group amounts unchanged in secondary reports). The guideline period (2021-22 to 2025-26) has ended; the content says so and tells users to check the portal.
